sourceContract: Claude Code hook JSON protocol (SubagentStop), read from the shipped CLI's own hook-input schemas, with a harness-attached `usage` object in the observed `message.usage` shape
author: otel-hook claude-code provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Shape only. Session, agent, and path values are fabricated; the assistant message is a placeholder. The counts are round numbers picked to sit at the extreme end of the observed ratio (a two-token fresh prompt against a 713,000-token cache read), chosen to prove the fold does not overflow or overlap at that ratio rather than to report any real turn.
licenseBasis: Original synthetic authorship: field names reproduce a third-party CLI's documented hook contract, all values are this repository's own.
notes: The cache-heavy case: almost nothing is fresh input. Pins that uncachedInputTokens falls out to the provider's own input_tokens even when cache reads dominate by five orders of magnitude. Exercised by tests/providers/claude/usage-contract.test.ts.
